profile.headline: Ed.M. candidate at Teachers College, Columbia University | Learning Experience Designer | Software Engineer | Researcher
profile.summary: Current Software Engineer with experience in both back end dev, front end dev, and service reliability. Experienced computer science educator for all grade levels and adults, and currently improving curriculum development skills through contract work. Would love to chat more about how computer science education can be more equitable and accessible.

positions.title: Technical Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught weekly classes in Python, from basic Python structure and beginner skills, to Django and web development, to algorithms/data structures and interview prep 
- Assisted in creating coding challenges to reinforce learning 
- Provided bi-weekly office hours to support students as needed 
- Collaborated to edit curriculum 

JTC will serve as a gateway for formerly incarcerated individuals to enter career track positions in the technology sector. It will focus on teaching formerly incarcerated individuals the fundamentals of programming in Python and web development, as well as providing interpersonal skills training and networking opportunities​ to assist students in becoming competitive applicants for jobs, internships, or future job/tech training​. The ​curriculum was developed by ​Mattan Griffel​, who received the Dean's Award for Teaching Excellence, and teaches a similar course at Columbia Business School.
positions.insights: Skills: Educational Technology · Django · Teaching · Python (Programming Language)

company.name: Justice Through Code at Columbia University

positions.title: Curriculum Developer
positions.description: - Developed curriculum as a part of a team for WEB101 and WEB102 classes for beginner and intermediate web development skills using HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and React
positions.insights: Skills: Instructional Design · Curriculum Development · HTML · JavaScript · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Technical Instructor
positions.description:
- Trained students (aged 16-25) on Python, Django web development, and sociotechnical curriculum for Hack the Hood summer programs
- Worked with a team of Technical Instructors and Curriculum Consultant to create instructor materials (course outlines, instructional videos, training aids, etc.)

positions.title: Coach
positions.description: - Taught and developed comprehensive lesson plans for material in HTML, JavaScript, and Scratch that accommodated middle and elementary school learners

positions.title: Research Co-Lead
positions.description:
• Manages student research and education projects (for example, developing a racial justice/tech curriculum that can be beta-tested in the annual YX fellowship)
• Leads creation and management of YX's digital and non-digital knowledge resources including internal audit of relevant academic research
• Collaborates with other leads to identify and spearhead interesting and impactful research and education projects which serve the mission of the YX Foundation
• Provides research support and guidance across all YX programs
• Provides thoughtful leadership that is inclusive, transparent, and empowering in a manner that supports and guides the organization’s mission

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Investigated multiple machine learning algorithms to analyze automation test results, telemetry, logs, failure buckets, and scenario coverage to identify groups of tests that often pass/fail in a correlated way
- Prototyped and productionized tool to automatically ingest data, pre-process and clean it, perform KMeans clustering algorithm, and output tests that may have similar behavior using Python

positions.title: Explore Intern
positions.description:
Planned, implemented, and installed a set of dashboard widgets in Azure DevOps to keep track of multiple Office teams’ branch health in Git.
- Widgets tracked multiple metrics for health based on customer needs and continuous customer feedback
- Designed accessible UI layout using HTML and React
- Created and iterated on backend to handle multiple API calls on Git information and sort through the correct records using TypeScript and Azure DevOps REST API.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description: Creates and maintains a Year Plan for high school students regarding academics, extracurricular activities, and standardized testing in order to build a stronger profile for college applications.

positions.title: Technical Intern - Software Engineering
positions.description:
Projects:
- migrated log4j (version 1.2.14 to version 2.8.2) framework for a pricing web based application 
- worked with SQL to create scripts for data patches and server migrations in the backend of another pricing web based application
- implemented and installed performance enhancement changes in the backend and frontend for a large scale global pricing application

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Math tutor in various math concepts ranging from elementary level to calculus.
